---
title: "GSE3307_Specificity_Test"
author: "Noor-Ul-Haya Ahmed"
date: "2026"
output: pdf_document
description: >
  Internal specificity analysis — tests whether the ALS skeletal
  muscle transcriptional signature is specific to neurodegeneration
  or reflects generic muscle disease responses. ALS samples from
  GSE3307 compared against five non-neurodegenerative muscle
  disease groups contained within the same dataset:
    JDM (n=21), SPG (n=4), DMD (n=10), FSHD (n=15), AQM (n=5)
  All 121 GSE3307 samples normalised together before comparison.
  Candidates classified as: ALS-specific (0/5), partially specific
  (1-2/5), or generic muscle disease (3-5/5).
  Updated biomarker scores saved to Biomarkers/.
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "...") # make own directory
```

```{r libraries}
library(limma)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(hgu133a.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

dir.create("Specificity", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load_full_gse3307}
# ============================================================
# LOAD FULL GSE3307 MATRIX (ALL 121 SAMPLES)
# Includes ALS, NHM controls, and all disease comparators:
# JDM, SPG, DMD, FSHD, AQM, BMD, Dysferlin, Calpain3,
# EDMD, FKRP, Exercise, MalHyp
# All 121 samples normalised TOGETHER before subsetting
# ============================================================

expr_full <- read.csv(
  "raw_data/GSE3307_expression_matrix.csv",
  row.names    = 1,
  check.names  = FALSE
)
expr_full <- as.matrix(expr_full)
mode(expr_full) <- "numeric"

cat("Full GSE3307 dimensions:", dim(expr_full), "\n")

# log2 transform + quantile normalise all 121 samples together
expr_log  <- log2(expr_full + 1)
expr_norm_full <- normalizeBetweenArrays(
  expr_log, method = "quantile"
)

cat("Normalisation complete\n")
```

```{r load_gse3307_metadata}
# ============================================================
# LOAD FULL GSE3307 METADATA
# Assign group labels from sample titles
# ============================================================

gse3307_1 <- getGEO(
  filename = "GSE3307-GPL96_series_matrix.txt",
  getGPL   = FALSE
)
pdata_3307 <- pData(gse3307_1)

# assign group labels from title prefix
pdata_3307$Group <- case_when(
  grepl("END-ALS",          pdata_3307$title) ~ "ALS",
  grepl("FSH-NHM|HUD-NHM", pdata_3307$title) ~ "Control",
  grepl("HUD-BMD",          pdata_3307$title) ~ "Exclude_BMD",
  grepl("YJD-JDM",          pdata_3307$title) ~ "JDM",
  grepl("HSP-Spg4|HSP-Spg7",pdata_3307$title) ~ "SPG",
  grepl("FSH-DMD|HUD-DMD",  pdata_3307$title) ~ "DMD",
  grepl("FSH-FSHD",         pdata_3307$title) ~ "FSHD",
  grepl("AQM",              pdata_3307$title) ~ "AQM",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

cat("Full GSE3307 group breakdown:\n")
table(pdata_3307$Group)
```

```{r als_top_candidates}
# ============================================================
# TOP ALS/PD CANDIDATE GENES TO TEST FOR SPECIFICITY
# From cross-disease comparison (shared ALS/PD genes)
# Plus ALS-robust genes from consistency analysis
# ============================================================

top_candidates <- c(
  "FOSL1", "TPRG1", "PILRB", "ACSS1", "RFLNA",
  "SLC40A1", "B3GLCT", "PDE7A",
  "MGST3", "RNASEL",
  "TNNC1", "MYH7", "TNNT1", "TNNI1", "MYOZ2",
  "SOCS3", "KCNN3", "TPM3", "PPP3CC", "PDLIM5"
)
```

```{r specificity_comparisons}
# ============================================================
# ALS VS EACH COMPARATOR — LIMMA
# Five comparators: JDM, SPG, DMD, FSHD, AQM
# Uses full normalised 121-sample matrix
# ============================================================

comparators <- c("JDM", "SPG", "DMD", "FSHD", "AQM")

for(comp in comparators){
  cat("\n--- ALS vs", comp, "---\n")

  try({

    comp_meta <- pdata_3307 %>%
      filter(Group %in% c("ALS", comp))

    cat("ALS:", sum(comp_meta$Group == "ALS"), "\n")
    cat(comp, ":", sum(comp_meta$Group == comp), "\n")

    if(sum(comp_meta$Group == comp) < 2){
      cat("Too few comparator samples — skipping\n")
      next
    }

    # subset full normalised matrix
    comp_expr <- expr_norm_full[,
      comp_meta$geo_accession[
        comp_meta$geo_accession %in% colnames(expr_norm_full)]]

    comp_meta <- comp_meta[
      match(colnames(comp_expr), comp_meta$geo_accession),
    ]

    stopifnot(
      identical(colnames(comp_expr), comp_meta$geo_accession)
    )

    group  <- factor(comp_meta$Group, levels = c(comp, "ALS"))
    design <- model.matrix(~ group)
    fit    <- lmFit(comp_expr, design)
    fit    <- eBayes(fit)

    res       <- topTable(fit, coef = 2,
                          number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
    res$probe <- rownames(res)

    # map probes to gene symbols
    symbols <- mapIds(
      hgu133a.db,
      keys      = res$probe,
      column    = "SYMBOL",
      keytype   = "PROBEID",
      multiVals = "first"
    )

    res$gene <- symbols
    res <- res %>%
      filter(!is.na(gene)) %>%
      group_by(gene) %>%
      slice_min(order_by = adj.P.Val,
                n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup()

    sig <- sum(res$adj.P.Val < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    cat("Significant genes (ALS vs", comp, "):", sig, "\n")

    overlap <- res %>%
      filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & gene %in% top_candidates)
    cat("Top candidates also sig vs", comp, ":",
        nrow(overlap), "/", length(top_candidates), "\n")

    write.csv(
      res %>% dplyr::select(gene, logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val),
      paste0("Specificity/ALS_vs_", comp, "_DE.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  })
}
```

```{r specificity_summary}
# ============================================================
# SPECIFICITY SUMMARY
# For each top candidate: count how many comparators
# it was significant in (padj < 0.05)
# Classify: ALS-specific (0), partially specific (1-2),
#           generic muscle disease (3-5)
# ============================================================

als_vs_jdm  <- read.csv("Specificity/ALS_vs_JDM_DE.csv",
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
als_vs_spg  <- read.csv("Specificity/ALS_vs_SPG_DE.csv",
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
als_vs_dmd  <- read.csv("Specificity/ALS_vs_DMD_DE.csv",
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
als_vs_fshd <- read.csv("Specificity/ALS_vs_FSHD_DE.csv",
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
als_vs_aqm  <- read.csv("Specificity/ALS_vs_AQM_DE.csv",
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

spec_data <- data.frame(
  gene        = top_candidates,
  sig_vs_JDM  = top_candidates %in%
    filter(als_vs_jdm,  adj.P.Val < 0.05)$gene,
  sig_vs_SPG  = top_candidates %in%
    filter(als_vs_spg,  adj.P.Val < 0.05)$gene,
  sig_vs_DMD  = top_candidates %in%
    filter(als_vs_dmd,  adj.P.Val < 0.05)$gene,
  sig_vs_FSHD = top_candidates %in%
    filter(als_vs_fshd, adj.P.Val < 0.05)$gene,
  sig_vs_AQM  = top_candidates %in%
    filter(als_vs_aqm,  adj.P.Val < 0.05)$gene
) %>%
  mutate(
    n_comparators = sig_vs_JDM + sig_vs_SPG + sig_vs_DMD +
                    sig_vs_FSHD + sig_vs_AQM,
    specificity_label = case_when(
      n_comparators == 0 ~ "ALS-specific",
      n_comparators <= 2 ~ "Partially specific",
      n_comparators >= 3 ~ "Generic muscle disease"
    ),
    specificity_score = 5 - n_comparators
  )

cat("=== SPECIFICITY SUMMARY ===\n")
print(spec_data %>%
        dplyr::select(gene, n_comparators, specificity_label))

write.csv(spec_data,
          "Specificity/ALS_specificity_summary.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r update_biomarker_scores}
# ============================================================
# UPDATE BIOMARKER SCORES WITH SPECIFICITY
# Add specificity component to base scores from
# 5_Cross_Study_Analysis.Rmd
# Final score = base score + specificity score
# ============================================================

shared_scored <- read.csv(
  "Biomarkers/ALS_PD_shared_scored.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# join specificity scores
shared_scored <- shared_scored %>%
  left_join(
    spec_data %>%
      dplyr::select(gene, sig_vs_JDM, sig_vs_SPG,
                    sig_vs_DMD, sig_vs_FSHD, sig_vs_AQM,
                    n_comparators_sig = n_comparators,
                    specificity_label, specificity_score),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    score_updated = score_base + replace_na(specificity_score, 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(score_updated))

cat("=== UPDATED TOP 15 BIOMARKER CANDIDATES ===\n")
print(shared_scored %>%
        dplyr::select(gene, score_updated,
                      specificity_label, n_comparators_sig) %>%
        head(15))

write.csv(shared_scored,
          "Biomarkers/ALS_PD_shared_scored_with_specificity.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r final_tier_assignment}
# ============================================================
# FINAL BIOMARKER TIER ASSIGNMENT
# Tier 1: pan-ND AND ALS-specific (0 comparators)
# Tier 2: ALS-specific only (0 comparators, not pan-ND)
# Tier 3: pan-ND, partially specific (1-2 comparators)
# Tier 4: partially specific (1-2 comparators, not pan-ND)
# Tier 5: pan-ND but generic (3-5 comparators)
# Tier 6: generic muscle disease (3-5 comparators, not pan-ND)
# ============================================================

final_table <- shared_scored %>%
  mutate(
    in_three_diseases = !is.na(n_comparators_sig),
    biomarker_tier = case_when(
      specificity_label == "ALS-specific" &
        in_three_diseases == TRUE  ~ "Tier 1: Pan-ND and ALS-specific",
      specificity_label == "ALS-specific" &
        in_three_diseases == FALSE ~ "Tier 2: ALS-specific only",
      specificity_label == "Partially specific" &
        in_three_diseases == TRUE  ~ "Tier 3: Pan-ND, partially specific",
      specificity_label == "Partially specific" ~
        "Tier 4: Partially specific",
      specificity_label == "Generic muscle disease" &
        in_three_diseases == TRUE  ~ "Tier 5: Pan-ND but generic",
      TRUE ~ "Tier 6: Generic muscle disease"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(biomarker_tier, desc(score_updated))

cat("=== FINAL TIER SUMMARY ===\n")
print(table(final_table$biomarker_tier))

write.csv(final_table,
          "Biomarkers/Final_Tiered_Biomarker_Candidates.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nAll specificity analysis complete.\n")
cat("Files saved to Specificity/ and Biomarkers/\n")
```
